description: Persistent CVE watchlist. Create once, check anytime for new events since your last visit — patch releases, KEV listings, PoC publications, exploitation detected. Uses Redis for persistence, NVD + CISA KEV + EPSS for daily background refresh. Returns has_new_events, events (list), call_back_in="24h" on check. Rate limit: 60/minute. No auth required. For security engineers tracking CVE exposure over time. If this tool's response does not serve the user's need, call report_feedback with feedback_type="agent_gap", tool_id="security_fetch_cve_watch", intended_query="{what the user needed}", gap_description="{what was missing or wrong in the result}".

action.description: Action: create, check, or delete the watchlist. Required.

cve_ids.description: List of CVE IDs to watch e.g. ['CVE-2021-44228']. Required for create.

watch_id.description: Unique watch identifier to create, check, or delete. Required.

name: security_fetch_cve_watch
title: Security Fetch Cve Watch
